messages:
maria: Quick sync  scheduling base-image rebuild + runtime harden next Wed 07:00 PT. Need RBAC delta, KMS signer details, and vuln triage owner.

oliver: I can handle RBAC. Which principals need cosign sign? signer-sa only? registry-deploy?

sandeep: signer-sa for signing, registry-deploy for pushes. Build-runners get storage.upload only. No writer on KMS.

emma: KMS: we'll use KMS-backed signing key (cosign). Need cloudkms.signer on signer-sa and audit alerts for key use. HSM not in staging yet.

sec-bot: Created INFSEC-510. Audit stream -> projects/redwood/logs/infra-audit. Retention 21d for this rollout.

devops: Preflight queued job 9981: build-slim -> sign -> push-staging -> attest -> smoke. cosign command: `cosign sign --key "kms://projects/redwood/.../cutover-key" image:tag`

maria: Also saw CVE-2026-8844 in openssl in current base. We'll rebuild with patched openssl and run syscall/runtime probes on canary. If setuid or NET_RAW appears, abort.

oliver: PR iam-configs#509 opened with minimal roles. Tagging reviewers.

sandeep: I'll run vuln scan and a focused syscall fuzz during canary. If anomalies > threshold, I'll signal abort.

emma: Added KMS rotation doc to ticket. Also setting PagerDuty rule for unexpected key use.

maria: Pre-cutover checklist: 1) RBAC merged 2) KMS IAM applied 3) cosign test pass 4) audit pipeline hooked 5) canary pass. Go/no-go at 06:30 Wed.

oliver: I'll add rollback snippet to PR.

sec-bot: Policy note: `deny-privileged-containers` enforced. Exceptions via INFSEC-511.

maria: Thanks team. Merge RBAC by EOD Mon unless blockers. Ping here for failures.
